1.name: Regular on-track students
1.description: Younger, mostly day-time students with a normal first-semester load who passed most of their units.
1.suggested_support: Standard monitoring. The cluster alone cannot show who is at risk, so use the model prediction.

0.name: Mature transfer / credited students
0.description: Older students with many units credited from previous studies, a heavy first-semester load and more evening classes.
0.suggested_support: Offer flexible scheduling and check workload and work or family constraints; academic remediation is usually not the main need.

2.name: No-progress students
2.description: Students who enrolled in first-semester units but passed almost none of them, with a first-semester grade of about zero.
2.suggested_support: Highest priority for early outreach: an academic recovery plan and a check of tuition status with student services.
